relevance.reason: General Assembly resolution on lethal autonomous weapons systems, adopted on the report of the First Committee. It affirms that international law, including international humanitarian law and human rights law, applies to autonomous weapons systems and addresses AI and autonomy in the military domain. It is non-binding and does not create a treaty regime.
